paper_title: Towards an electrostatic storage ring for fundamental physics measurements
coupling_convention: dimensionless g_ae (approximate, read from plot axis range)
notes: Projection paper (proposal) for an electrostatic storage ring. Fig. 4 shows projected axion-electron coupling sensitivity (left) and axion-nucleon (right), plus kinetically mixed dark photon. The pre-analysis hint of AxionEDM is not the main dark-matter exclusion plot; the primary DM sensitivity curves are for axion-electron and axion-nucleon couplings. No numerical data table is provided; the axis ranges (mass 1e-19 to 1e-9 eV, coupling ~1e-11 to 1e-8) are only rough estimates read from Fig. 4 labels. Actual sensitivity curve values are not extractable with confidence. Multiple coupling types (g_ae, g_an, dark photon chi, EDM) discussed, so coupling type is genuinely ambiguous and data points are unreliable. | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing experiment 'comagnetometer' — not the paper's own projected curve ; [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of existing (grey/black) constraints') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: text (sole candidate)
